DECKS:



Light: Chandra Fan BEATS

Dark : Court







pre tournie sh!p:





well, ya

i playtested my light deck, the day befor, against my friends hunt down and i lost by 7. Then i went to the tournie and i barrowed a tessek and a Galid. i also was given an obi w stick by zack something(thanx a ton).





end tournie sh!p----







game 1: light vs doughlas havillas huntdown



well, so I get tessek and kabe in hand first turn, not bad? Ann then I set up bo shuda and I pull a bothnian spy with you wiil take me to jabba now. Then I flip and start to drain. He flips on tatione and I cancel vasage with the spy. Draing war and then he beats me down with 5 mains at the exuctutor and I lose by 13, that’s basicly game.



   Fl 0(-24)

Props: none

Slops: losing by a lot less if I didn’t cancel visage.







Game 2: my court against profit

Not cool, I hate profit, todally screws over my scum but anyway…

Set up some guys and get hearded over to mos isly with all his mains. Again a drain war with profit doing damage the whole time. Then I capture his r2 and  2 other guys, bring them to the dungen and retrive 6, donsn’t help much but hey. Then I hit han but I lose all my guys, he uses ben to retrive him. Then I lose from profit and mains.



FL 0(-50)

Props: again none

Slops: losing to the only deck I’m suppose to beat.



*** so now I’m at the lower table***







Game 3: my fans and his huntdown

Well I basicly do nothing!!! I can’t drain and hes killing me with  3 scouts and some good interrupts. Io cancel visage but too late, don’t get to retrive with no mice on table, no fun!



FL 0(-76)



















Game 4: my court against hidden base

Well, I know this kids friend and he’s played about 5 times. So I try to help him when playing. I set up gaild and hutt influence with the 2 guys necisary to drain. Then I help him after he flips by telling him to to spread out early game and to drain then later game bunch up and drain, he was gona bunch up then so I couldn’t kill him but it was like turn 3. so he does the drains and I get out scum and firct strike, then I play down buba and I attack, I retrive 4 and he loses 2(he had draw there fire) so I;m happy, we both tie and I move. Then I;m draining for 6 each turn and 1 to the objective while I’m retriving, when I get down to hime with 1 force left I attack and retrive lost pile and he loses the game.



FW 2(-15)

Props: did ok and I played with good statigies.

Slops: I tried to help but I wasn’t gona lose on purpose. I felt sorry for him but he didn’t mind it.









Game 5: my court against his profit and harvest

Well, this was another bad game, I basicly am getting screwd over and AGAIN hearded into the couner and deing. I’m feeling good cause this guys really nice and cool so I ask what his differencial is, he says 32, so I make a deal to lose by 33 giving him +1 for fun. This is a really great guy(sean estes) so it’s no biggy. So I let hime harvest for 6 or so turns and I draw up.



FL 2(-48)



Props: losing for fun and to a great guy to help his differenal. I was so low ot didn’t matter.

Slops: almost none, I need to get a better court idea



Game 6: my fans vs my best friend huntdown, the same I lsot by 7 to

Well, somehow everytime I’ve played I get tessek so I set up tesske and draw for a take me to jabba now or a kabe. Then I set up bo shuda and camp the kabe and tessek. Then I canel visage with my bothnain spy and 2 rats for forfit protection(I was thinking about the time I caneled with no protection, smart huh?) so then I set up the drains. He battles and I beat him I do it over and over and make him lose to first strike. Hes got 5 card left and I drain for all but 1 then I retive 6 and I drain. Fun game and It worked.



FW 4(-24)

Props: my deck has awesome beat down portental and it worked.

Slops: my friens played a guy who cheats so he shouldn’t have played me, but we had fun.







Over all: got cards and tips, it was fun, there always fun.



Post tournie junk:



Well I talk to Joe Olson on how to win and he helps me with my light side deck. He gave me a tessek and a wise advise and some other great tips. (thanx again Joe) then he also hel;ps with some orignal statiges for my court.



I had fun. Star Wars ROCKS!!!



*** note: i’ll be posting the new decks soon, stand by***

summary: Denny Chapin went 2–4 (4, −24) at a local tournament in Seattle, Washington, on 6 January 2001 with a Chadra-Fan Light deck and Court, losing his first game to Douglas Harvilla.
notes: The report gives no date or count. Identified as the 6 January 2001 Seattle event of Douglas Harvilla's d1594: Harvilla beat 'Denny Chapin's Agents In The Court (Chadra-Fans)' in round 1, Chapin opens with 'doughlas havillas huntdown', and both mention Joe Olson and a 'Zach'/'zack'; posted 8 January 2001, the day after d1594. Same event name, 'January 2001 Seattle tournament'.
Format Premiere - Jabba's Palace Sealed Deck (before Reflections II, per d1594).

Opponents: Douglas Harvilla (existing, misspelled 'doughlas havillas') and Sean Estes (existing Seattle player) linked; the others are unnamed. 'zack something' who lent him an Obi-Wan with saber is probably [[Zach Jones]] (d1594), not linked. [[Joe Olson]] gave him tips after the event (winner per d1594; not used as event_winner here).

Margins: only game 1 ('lose by 13') and game 5 (the agreed loss by 33) are stated. Game 1's running total is −24 and Harvilla records +22 (discrepancy entry on d1594). Other margins left null; running totals in the game notes.

Objectives: Dark 'Court' linked to Court Of The Vile Gangster; opponents' Hunt Down (original), Profit and Hidden Base linked. His Light 'Chandra Fan BEATS' (Chadra-Fans with Bo Shuda) has no objective named here; Harvilla calls it Agents In The Court, but that is not used for the author's own deck.
Finish not given ('so now I'm at the lower table').

Deck pages: [[Denny Chapin How Did I Just Lose To Rats Again]] (27 December 2000) and [[Denny Chapin Rat Rampage]] (11 January 2001) are Chadra-Fan lists around this date, but he borrowed Tessek and Gailid on the day and says new decks are coming, so deck_page not set.

discrepancies.text: Douglas Harvilla records his round 1 win over Denny Chapin as +22; Chapin writes that he lost 'by 13', and his running total after the game is −24.
